title: VMF saved size catalog
description: WAVEGEN-HOSTED-1. The part of one region's Azure size catalog a target can come from - D, E and F sizes of v5, v6 and v7 - and, from v2 (WAVE-MIX-2), the sizes the plan's machines are on, saved beside a plan by the engine when it builds the plan (catalog/<location>.json). The service cannot read Azure's catalog: it ships Az.Accounts only and its identity holds no Microsoft.Compute/skus/read. So a size-series change made through the service reads this copy. It is the catalog as it was when the plan was built. MIGRATION NOTE v1 to v2: v2 adds the source sizes, because whether a source has a temporary disk decides a v5 d size and a v2 or v3 size says so only in the catalog. A v1 file stays valid and is read the same way; lacking the source sizes, a change that would need one is refused by the agreement check, never given a different size.

location.description: The region, lower case, as Azure names it.

readUtc.description: When the engine read the catalog.

name.description: A target size (D, E or F at v5 to v7) or, from v2, a size a machine in the plan is on.

family.description: The quota family Azure reports for the size. Never inferred from the name.
